items.te: Maple Finance’s strategy rift sends co-founder, COO to the exits
items.se: Maple Finance co-founder Joe Flanagan and COO Ryan O’Shea are leaving over disagreements about the firm’s direction as SYRUP falls despite revenue growth.
items.t: Maple Finance的策略分歧導致共同創辦人、營運長退出
items.s: Maple Finance 聯合創始人 Joe Flanagan 和營運長 Ryan O’Shea 因對公司發展方向存在分歧而離職，儘管收入增長，但 SYRUP 卻出現下滑。
